evals.prompt: 幫我做一份 8 頁的產品發表簡報，介紹一個叫 Pulse 的團隊協作工具，給投資人看的 pitch deck。
evals.expected_output: A single self-contained HTML deck (~8 slides) at 1920×1080: cover, problem, solution, a big-number traction slide, comparison, closing. One coherent style preset, body text ≥28px, one idea per slide, no overflow. Passes check_deck.py with 0 errors.

evals.prompt: Turn these notes into slides for a 20-minute conference talk on database connection pooling. Keep it speaker-led — I'll be presenting live.
evals.expected_output: A speaker-led deck: 1–3 bullets per slide, large type, more slides, section dividers for rhythm. Single HTML file, dark-neon or technical preset suits the topic. No slide exceeds the vertical budget; check_deck.py clean.

evals.prompt: 我有一份公司的 PowerPoint 模板，可以照它的風格幫我把這份產品週報做成投影片嗎？
evals.expected_output: Recognizes path D: offers to extract the .pptx (extract_pptx.py / python-pptx) for content + style, matches its palette/fonts into an original preset, rebuilds as an HTML deck without redistributing the source file. Asks for the file or the outline.

evals.name: role-lock-registered-labels
evals.prompt: 做一份 6 頁的內部架構審查簡報（任一主題），做完跑一次 check_deck.py 給我看結果。
evals.expected_output: Every <section class="slide"> in the generated deck carries a data-label naming a role registered in references/layouts.md (cover/agenda/section/content/bignumber/quote/comparison/timeline/closing, hyphen/case variants OK) — no invented role names. check_deck.py reports 0 errors and no 'no data-label' / 'not a registered role' warnings. If the deck were labeled with an invented role (e.g. data-label="hero-mega"), the checker must flag it.
